_meta.data_freshness: Program existence, type, chain/ecosystem, region, and dilution posture are evergreen and verified through June 2026. TIME-SENSITIVE fields (application deadlines, open/closed cohort status, current prize pool / check size, cadence) are baseline snapshots and MUST be re-verified live before the user applies or acts.
_meta.coverage: Global. Every entry is region-tagged. Southeast Asia / Vietnam-relevant entries carry sea_relevant: true.

opportunities.name: a16z Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: ~$500K on a post-money SAFE/equity
opportunities.notes: Intensive multi-week program from a16z crypto. Network-heavy, founder-friendly. Check the official page for the next cohort window.

opportunities.name: Alliance DAO
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment + demo day; equity/token terms vary
opportunities.notes: "By founders, for founders"; famously selective. Alumni include Pump.fun, Pendle, Tensor, 0x, Synthetix. Strong web3-native network.

opportunities.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment for equity/tokens + token-design support
opportunities.notes: Often called the "YC of Web3"; 300+ startups accelerated. "Post-Web" thesis (internet for humans and machines). Token-launch and go-to-market focus.

opportunities.name: Tachyon (CoinList) Accelerator
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment for equity/tokens
opportunities.notes: Early-stage crypto accelerator associated with the CoinList ecosystem. Verify current program branding and cohort status on the official site.

opportunities.name: YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Strategic investment; size varies by stage
opportunities.notes: Investment and incubation arm formerly known as Binance Labs. Strong reach into Asia/SEA markets and BNB Chain ecosystem.

opportunities.name: Base ecosystem accelerator (Coinbase / Base)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Program support, ecosystem grants, and investor access
opportunities.notes: Builder programs around the Base L2 (Coinbase). Mix of non-dilutive ecosystem support and investor connections. Check Base's builders hub for current batch.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Eternal (Solana accelerator)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment into hackathon-winning teams
opportunities.notes: Accelerator + venture arm that funds top Solana hackathon teams (see hackathon entry colosseum-hackathon). SEA founders compete and raise remotely.

opportunities.name: Draper University Web3 / Crypto programs
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Program + potential investment
opportunities.notes: Founder training and accelerator with recurring crypto/web3 tracks. Confirm current web3-specific cohort on the official site.

opportunities.name: Antler (Web3 track)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Pre-seed check (typically equity) after the residency
opportunities.notes: Day-zero venture builder with strong SEA presence (Singapore, Jakarta, etc.) and recurring web3/crypto cohorts. Good for solo founders seeking co-founders.

opportunities.name: Founders, Inc. (f.inc)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Space, resources, and investment for some teams
opportunities.notes: San Francisco builder studio/incubator with a strong crypto and frontier-tech community. Frequent hackathons and residencies.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Non-dilutive grants; size varies by scope
opportunities.notes: Funds public-goods, infrastructure, research, and tooling for the Ethereum ecosystem. Not for-profit product funding; read the scope before applying.

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: ARB grants, milestone-based; tiered amounts (incl. focused funds like Trailblazer)
opportunities.notes: Ecosystem grants for tooling, infra, and apps on Arbitrum (an Ethereum L2). Recent focused tracks have targeted agentic DeFi. Pair with DAO grant rounds.

opportunities.name: Optimism Grants (proactive)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP token grants via Collective grant programs
opportunities.notes: Forward-looking grants from the Optimism Collective. Distinct from Retro Funding (see optimism-retro-funding), which pays after impact.

opportunities.name: Base Ecosystem / Builder Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Retroactive builder grants (often small ETH amounts) + ecosystem support
opportunities.notes: Grants for builders shipping on Base. Tends toward smaller, fast, retroactive rewards for active builders. Verify the current round format.

opportunities.name: Web3 Foundation Grants (Polkadot / Kusama)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants paid in stablecoin/DOT
opportunities.notes: Funds open-source software and research for Polkadot, Kusama, and Substrate. Application and milestone delivery are managed publicly on GitHub.

opportunities.name: Interchain Foundation Grants (Cosmos)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Grants for Cosmos/IBC ecosystem development
opportunities.notes: Supports core infrastructure, IBC, and tooling across the Cosmos ecosystem. Check current funding vehicles and RFPs.

opportunities.name: NEAR Foundation Grants / Ecosystem funding
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants and program funding
opportunities.notes: Funding for builders on NEAR, including AI x crypto and chain-abstraction themes. Regional dev programs reach Asia/SEA.

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants for Sui ecosystem projects
opportunities.notes: Grants for infrastructure, tooling, and apps on Sui (Mysten Labs). Read current focus areas before applying.

opportunities.name: Filecoin / Protocol Labs Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Open grants and RFPs; milestone-based
opportunities.notes: Decentralized storage and data ecosystem grants. Proposals are filed and reviewed openly in the devgrants GitHub repo.

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal (hackathon series)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Per-event prize pools (commonly $200K+) across sponsor tracks
opportunities.cadence: multiple in-person + online events per year
opportunities.notes: The flagship Ethereum hackathon series (Cannes, New York, Lisbon, Tokyo, Mumbai, plus online editions). Non-dilutive prizes; strong recruiting/investor surface.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Solana Hackathons (Frontier, etc.)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large prize pools (often $1M+) + investment into top teams via Eternal
opportunities.notes: Official Solana Foundation hackathon org. Prizes are non-dilutive, but winners can raise into the Colosseum/Eternal accelerator (dilutive). Open to SEA founders remotely.

opportunities.name: DoraHacks (global hackathon + BUIDL platform)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Hackathon prizes + quadratic-funding grant rounds
opportunities.notes: Global hacker movement and grant platform hosting hackathons for many chains. Frequent SEA and Asia events. Combines prizes with QF grants.

opportunities.name: Polkadot ecosystem hackathons
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Per-event prize pools
opportunities.notes: Recurring Polkadot/Substrate hackathons run with ecosystem partners. Check the community events calendar for the current season.

opportunities.name: Gitcoin Grants & Bounties
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Quadratic-funding matching rounds + bounties
opportunities.notes: Public-goods funding via quadratic funding (Grants Stack) plus a bounties marketplace. Best for open-source and community-backed projects.

opportunities.name: Immunefi (security bug bounties)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bug-bounty payouts (up to millions for critical findings)
opportunities.notes: The largest web3 bug-bounty platform. For security researchers earning payouts, and for projects funding their own bounty programs.

opportunities.name: Optimism Retro Funding (RetroPGF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP rewards distributed for proven ecosystem impact
opportunities.notes: Pays builders AFTER measurable impact rather than on promises. Best for projects already shipping value to the Optimism/Superchain ecosystem.

opportunities.name: Drips (continuous retroactive dependency funding)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Streamed funds to open-source dependencies
opportunities.notes: Lets projects stream retroactive funding to the open-source dependencies they rely on. Good for OSS maintainers in the Ethereum ecosystem.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Stipend + mentorship to contribute to Ethereum core protocol
opportunities.notes: Mentorship-driven fellowship for contributing to Ethereum protocol development. For engineers wanting core-protocol experience, not product funding.

opportunities.name: Solana ecosystem developer fellowships / bootcamps
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Training, stipend/credits, and ecosystem access
opportunities.notes: Solana Foundation runs developer fellowships and regional bootcamps (incl. India/SEA) to grow ecosystem builders. Verify the current program via the Foundation site.

opportunities.name: Sky Mavis / Ronin ecosystem grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants for games/apps on Ronin
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-rooted (Sky Mavis / Axie Infinity) gaming-focused L1 ecosystem. Relevant for SEA game and consumer-app builders. Confirm current grant vehicle.

opportunities.name: Kyros Ventures / Coin98 ecosystem programs
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Early-stage investment + regional go-to-market support
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-based research/venture group (Coin98 ecosystem). Strong SEA distribution and market-entry support for regional founders.

opportunities.name: Hashed Emergent (India / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment for equity/tokens + regional network
opportunities.notes: Emerging-markets-focused web3 venture/accelerator (India and Southeast Asia). Good for founders targeting high-growth Asian markets.

opportunities.name: Tribe Accelerator (Singapore)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Investment + enterprise/government partner access
opportunities.notes: Singapore government-backed blockchain accelerator with enterprise connections across SEA. Verify whether a current cohort is open.

opportunities.name: sqrDAO builder programs & bounties (Vietnam / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Community bounties, hackathon support, and builder programs
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-rooted web3 builder community running bounties, workshops, and hackathon support across SEA. Local on-ramp for regional founders.
